description: "The self-executing spine-forging chain for standalone identity work — when the endpoint is a portable system prompt, not a built engine. Discriminates input type (bare theme / loaded fragments / two completed spines), routes to the correct forging organ, enforces assay as a mandatory non-skippable gate, then opens the post-assay fork: compress to paste, radiate to population, or alloy with a second spine. Claude drives the chain; assay failure routes back to the forging organ with the named re-entry constraint. The practitioner chooses only at the post-assay fork. Invoke with /spine-pipe, 'forge a spine', 'I need a system prompt for this', 'spine only no build', 'forging identity not engine', 'portable prompt', or any phrase signaling intent to produce a standalone spine without proceeding to an engine build. Voice-tolerant — loose trigger matching."
